item.title: Upcoming Events
item.description:
SKEGNESS COACH TRIP

Sunday 13th September 2026

Back by popular demand! Our second bi-annual day trip to Skegness for our members, friends and families.

Tickets are available on a first-come, first-served basis and are very reasonably priced at just £15. Renal patients will get refunded on the day.

Sunday 13th September

Coach departs Leicester General Hospital @8AM

Coach return leaves Skegness @5PM

Tickets are just £15 and are available now, call: 07702 703882 or email: leiclkpa@gmail.com

item.title: Previous Events
item.description:
Social contact is important for mental health and wellbeing, we hold events throughout the year for patients and their family members why not come along and join us.

We try to arrange a variety of events to suit different tastes and interests.

SKEGNESS COACH TRIP 2026

Sunday 7th June 2026

Our first bi-annual day trip of the year to Skegness for our members, friends and families sold out quickly and was a great success!
